title: Cloud Yatra — Grafana Cloud alert recommendations
note: Faro custom events arrive in Loki with kind=event (field event_name) and measurements with kind=measurement (values as value_<name>, e.g. value_fps, value_lcp). Set your Faro app_id in place of APP_ID and tune thresholds after observing real play; keep labels bounded. Matches cloud-yatra-grand-observatory.json.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra browser exceptions
rules.purpose: Catch JavaScript errors affecting the playable experience.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra low sampled FPS
rules.query: avg_over_time({kind="measurement", app_id="APP_ID"} | logfmt | type="game_client_perf" | unwrap value_fps [10m])
rules.purpose: Detect a sustained poor browser experience without treating one slow device as an incident.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra slow LCP
rules.query: quantile_over_time(0.95, {kind="measurement", app_id="APP_ID"} | logfmt | type="web-vitals" | unwrap value_lcp [10m])
rules.purpose: Detect a meaningful real-user loading regression.
rules.note: Web-vitals LCP is emitted by Faro's own instrumentation, not by this game's code — confirm the measurement 'type' value and the unwrap field (value_lcp) in Grafana Explore against real data before enabling.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra death spike
rules.purpose: Spot a sudden gameplay difficulty or level-design problem.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra telemetry quiet
rules.purpose: A demo-room reminder that no new game session has arrived; investigate only during an active presentation.
